items.speaker: Mother
items.text: Shuttlebones ... I remember her. She knew your father once.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Yes. The Yamen has confirmed she was the ringleader behind the raid on Zhu County that night.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: All those caught in that raid were executed, save for her. She fled with a handful of others, disappearing near the Riverside Village.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If she yet lives after all these years, she has likely lowered her guard and settled into an ordinary life.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If I resolve this, I'll have amassed enough merit to fill the opening for the constable. And the reward sum will surely help us in the meantime.

items.speaker: Mother
items.text: You'll finally have some standing, and those brutes at the Yamen won't push you around any longer. *cough, cough*

items.speaker: Mother
items.text: Your father told me a little about Shuttlebones before. She is powerful, a reliable ally, and a formidable foe.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'll be careful. Besides, there are few anywhere in Huanzhou Prefecture who can match the blade techniques you taught me.

items.speaker: Mother
items.text: Haha. That's good to hear.

items.speaker: Mother
items.text: I worry that you're pushing yourself too hard.
Chéng takes his sword down from the wall.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No need to worry.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This is what I've always wanted, and it's the only right way forward.
Foot of Mountain, Riverside Village
Amid a clearing in the mountain woods, Chéng stands peering up at the trees.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So this is what you meant by a duel?
Doctor Xiù perches with one leg propped on a tree branch, calmly twirling the bone shuttle in her hand.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: This is how I toyed with Yamen officers when I was young. You should never expect an enemy to fight on your terms.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So be it.
Chéng draws his blade, cleaving the high branch in a single strike.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Hmph. That's what they used to do, too.
A silver thread shoots out from the swaying leaves, carrying Doctor Xiù safely to the high branches of another tree.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Never worked back then either.
Chéng sends several leaves shooting upward. They fall short before reaching their mark.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: You're wasting your energy. I know your arcane skill cannot reach so high.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Then I'll drag you back down!
The sword whirls in his hands, the force trembling the surrounding pines.
After several moments, Doctor Xiù cannot help but sigh.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Ah, you foolish boy. Tell me, what do you believe this will achieve?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: This little thread of mine can go very far. Allow me to demonstrate.
A longer silver thread extends from her outstretched arm, propelling her toward a distant tree.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Hmm?
The silver thread snaps, sending her hurtling back to the ground.
Two metal leaves fall from the air in her wake.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Nicely done.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: When you swing between the trees, you lose some height. How much you drop depends on the length of the silver thread.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No matter how long your thread, my arcane skill will be able to reach you.
Chéng braces his blade before him.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Are you ready to finish this?
Doctor Xiù turns her back and begins to amble off along the mountain path.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: No, I'm tired now.
Chéng stares at her back, confused, before deciding to follow after her.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If you never meant to fight, why challenge me? Why lure me here?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Why the hurry? You can't be sure you'll beat me, can you? Ever heard of keeping your blade sheathed and waiting for the perfect moment to strike?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: And even if you were to win, what then?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I would take you to the Yamen.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: The very moment you defeat me?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: No. Not until every patient in the clinic is healed.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Then you'll be waiting for a long time! Over a thousand people live in that Riverside Village. Three days don't pass without someone knocking at the door!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Besides, there are still some patients in the clinic right now, are there not? So what's the rush? We'll come back to this tomorrow.
The Next Day

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Fallen leaves scatter, turning into metallic blades as they tangle with silver thread.
They streak through the air in a blur, impossible to make out.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: You're improving quickly. Most struggle to see my thread, let alone defend against it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Still not fast enough. I can't catch the silver thread's Qi. I can't turn it into metal.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You're shielding the bone shuttle in your grip. Its Qi resistance is too strong. I can't properly use my arcane skill.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I can't allow you to destroy my weapon that quickly. I have a reputation to uphold.
Several blackened silver threads coil around the edge of Chéng's blade.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: You rely too much on your arcane skill. Your metallization is irreversible. You've even trapped your own blade.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: As the silver thread whips around Chéng's neck, the wild grass beneath Doctor Xiù's feet lashes upward in stabbing arcs.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: The blades of grass halt at her throat.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Handling so many at once. I underestimated you.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Urgh. Let's call it a draw.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Fine.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: We'll stop here for today.
Yard, Clinic
After some hours of training in the woods, Chéng returns to the clinic a little late.
Several villagers are helping the hunter as he heads home. When he spots Chéng, he raises a hand in greeting.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: I'm on the mend and ready to head home. Doctor Xiù has plenty of work to do. Last thing she needs is me taking up more of her time.

items.speaker: Hunter
items.text: I heard you killed that tiger! Why didn't you tell me sooner? I'll head back to the village and let everyone know!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I only did what was necessary. No need to make a fuss.
The man doesn't hear a word, only shuffling off with a foolish grin on his face.
Chéng enters the clinic to find Doctor Xiù seated by the medicine stove, gently fanning the flames.
A few days earlier, Doctor Xiù sent her assistant to prepare medicine for the Hú household. Now it is only the two of them.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: With such skills in medicine, why become a bandit?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Because I wanted to be a hero.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Righteous ends must be pursued through righteous means. However they justify it, bandits inevitably bring harm to the innocent.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: There's no reasoning with someone as immovable as you. Distributing the grain I'd stolen from the officials to the poor—that is a life worth living!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: And robbing the people of Zhu County? Is that your idea of heroism?
Doctor Xiù keeps her eyes on the medicine stove, seemingly oblivious to Chéng's words.
A long silence passes before she replies.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: No. I know I don't have the stuff to be a hero. But, living here and being a doctor respected by the people? That I can do.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Tell me, what happened to your father?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You didn't know?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Sorry, I was running for my life back then, too busy pretending to be something I'm not, hah.
She chuckles with a trace of self-mockery.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: And after that, well, I settled into a life of black tiles and white walls. Every day filled with the simple chatterings of villagers and patients, knowing nothing of the outside world.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I told you he passed away.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: He confessed to his crimes and accepted his punishment.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I see.
Doctor Xiù lifts the lid of the medicine pot and peers inside. In an instant, the clinic fills with the bitter scent of herbs.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The villagers speak so highly of your medical skills. Do you know anything about treating consumption? Any special remedies?

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: What are the symptoms? How long has it been?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It began the winter before last. At first there was only coughing and night sweats, but the cough worsened rapidly.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Over the past three months, she's been coughing up blood quite frequently, suffering severe chest pain, and often says she has trouble breathing.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: There's nothing I can do.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The doctors in Zhu County said the same.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: They were right. I'm afraid she won't make it through the year.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: I'm assuming she's someone special to you?
Without a word, Chéng turns his back and leaves the clinic.
After a while, the medicine in the pot begins to bubble over.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Chéng Héguāng, pass me the ladle!

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Chéng Héguāng!
Hearing no response, Doctor Xiù steps away from the stove and heads outside.
Foot of Mountain, Riverside Village
A small patch of grass grows just outside the clinic.
Now, that grass is a weapon. Every leaf has been turned into a blade, whirling in tight clusters on the wind.
They dart through the wind, striking one another with a sharp, metallic clang.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: This is unfair.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: It is. But remember, Chéng: flowers bloom and fade, grass withers and thrives. All is governed by the Lord of Spring.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'd never have expected such words from you.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Hah. I'm from a medical family. Just a handful of verses picked up in my youth, that's all.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Not fond of that kind of talk?
The needle-fine metal shards freeze in midair, then scatter across the ground.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'll clean this up.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: You've cleaned enough. You should head home.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I'm not done here.

items.speaker: Doctor Xiu
items.text: Yes, well, we can take care of that tomorrow.
